title: Corneal abrasion from contact lens
notes: Needs eye exam only, discharged with prescription. No resources.

input.complaint: I was taking my contacts out last night and I think I scratched my cornea. The light really bothers my eyes. My right eye is red and tearing.

title: Medication overdose with respiratory depression
notes: RR 10, SpO2 86% — cannot protect airway, needs intubation. SpO2 < 90 should fire A5.

input.complaint: EMS brought in this 18-year-old found lethargic and not acting right by her roommates. History of depression. Multiple superficial lacerations to both wrists. She is barely breathing.

title: Self-inflicted gunshot wound to head, intubated
notes: Intubated, GCS 3. A1_intubated should fire.

input.complaint: EMS arrived with an unresponsive 19-year-old male with a single self-inflicted gunshot wound to the head. He was intubated by EMS. Before intubation his Glasgow Coma Scale was 3.

title: Blood pressure medication refill
notes: Prescription refill, BP controlled, no complaints. No resources.

input.complaint: I ran out of my blood pressure medicine and my doctor is on vacation. Can someone here write me a prescription? No other complaints.

title: Bicycle fall, wrist pain plus elbow laceration
notes: Needs X-ray of wrist AND suture of elbow laceration = 2 resources.

input.complaint: I fell off my bike and landed on my right arm. I have pain in my wrist area and a 2-centimeter laceration on my left elbow. My helmet saved me.

title: Shortness of breath, smoker on birth control
notes: RR 32, SpO2 93%, smoker on BCP — high risk for PE. Handbook says ESI 2.

input.complaint: I have had shortness of breath for several hours. I am a smoker and I take birth control pills.

title: Near-drowning, child unresponsive
notes: 4-year-old near-drowning, breathing spontaneously but unresponsive. A7 should fire.

input.complaint: My 4-year-old was pulled out of the family pool by a neighbor who gave mouth-to-mouth. The child is now breathing on his own but continues to be unresponsive.

title: Child with abdominal pain and vomiting
notes: 7-year-old, abdominal workup needs labs + CT/ultrasound = 2 resources.

input.complaint: My son woke up with a stomach ache. He refused to walk downstairs and is not interested in eating or playing. He just vomited.

title: Child with knee laceration
notes: Laceration needs suturing = 1 resource.

input.complaint: I was running across the playground and fell. I have a cut over my right knee. Immunizations are up to date.

title: Wrist injury after slipping on ice
notes: Needs X-ray to rule out fracture = 1 resource. Splint is not a resource.

input.complaint: I slipped on the ice and I hurt my wrist. There is no obvious deformity.

title: Child fall with loss of consciousness
notes: 4-year-old, witnessed fall with LOC, change in consciousness. High risk.

input.complaint: My 4-year-old fell off the jungle gym at preschool, about a 4 foot fall. A witness says she hit her head and was unconscious for a couple of minutes. She is crying and asking for me. Her left arm is splinted.

title: Suspected urinary tract infection
notes: Dysuria and frequency, no abdominal pain. Needs urinalysis = 1 resource (lab).

input.complaint: I think I have a urinary tract infection. I have burning when I urinate and I am going frequently. No abdominal pain or vaginal discharge.

title: Febrile neonate, 2 weeks old
notes: T 101F (38.3C) in infant < 28 days. Must be ESI 2 regardless of appearance.

input.complaint: My pediatrician told me to bring him in because of his fever. He is 2 weeks old, an uncomplicated vaginal delivery, and is otherwise acting appropriately.

title: Motor vehicle crash with shock
notes: Unrestrained driver, 45 mph, BP 74/50, HR 132, RR 36 — signs of shock. ESI 1.

input.complaint: Paramedics arrived with a 16-year-old unrestrained driver who hit a tree at about 45 miles per hour. The passenger side had significant damage. He was moaning but moving all extremities. He looks pale.

title: Smoke inhalation with airway compromise
notes: Hoarse, sore throat, working hard to breathe after smoke inhalation. Handbook says ESI 1 (likely needs intubation). May reveal a gap if our engine returns ESI 2 via B42.

input.complaint: The smoke was so bad I just couldn't breathe. I went into my burning apartment to rescue my cat. I am hoarse, my throat is sore, and I am coughing. I am working hard to breathe. I have asthma.

title: Red swollen great toe in diabetic
notes: Likely gout/cellulitis. Needs labs + IV antibiotics = 2 resources.

input.complaint: My right foot hurts. The great toe and foot are red, warm, swollen, and tender to touch. I deny any injury.

title: Postpartum mastitis with fever
notes: Needs labs + IV antibiotics = 2 resources.

input.complaint: My right breast is so sore, my nipples are cracked, and now I have a fever. I am 3 months postpartum and recently went back to work.

title: Asthmatic with likely pneumonia
notes: Not in acute distress. Needs labs + chest x-ray + IV antibiotics.

input.complaint: I have asthma and have had a cold for a week. A few days ago I started wheezing, then developed a cough and a fever of 103.

title: Toothache without swelling
notes: Pain 9/10 but no abscess/cellulitis. Exam only, referred to dentist. No resources.

input.complaint: I have an awful toothache in my right lower jaw. I lost my dental insurance so I haven't seen a dentist for a couple of years. No swelling that I can see.

title: Vomiting and diarrhea, possible food poisoning
notes: Needs labs + IV fluids + IV antiemetic. Not high risk or severe pain.

input.complaint: I think I have food poisoning. I have been vomiting all night and now I have diarrhea, with abdominal cramping. No fever or chills.

title: Migraine with vomiting
notes: Known migraine history. Needs pain med + antiemetic + fluids. Pain only 6/10.

input.complaint: My migraine started early this morning and I can't get it under control. I just keep vomiting. Can I lie down somewhere? I have a history of migraines.

title: Finger laceration from bagel slicing
notes: Needs laceration repair = 1 resource. Tetanus booster is NOT a resource.

input.complaint: I cut my finger trying to slice a bagel. There is a 2-centimeter cut on my left first finger. Bleeding is controlled. My last tetanus shot was 10 years ago.

title: Hyperemesis in early pregnancy
notes: 7 weeks pregnant, dehydrated. Needs labs + IV fluids + IV antiemetic.

input.complaint: I am 7 weeks pregnant and every time I try to eat something I throw up. My doctor sent me to the ED because he thinks I am getting dehydrated. My lips are dry and cracked.

title: Leg ache after prolonged sitting
notes: DVT risk after long car ride. Needs labs + lower-extremity vascular ultrasound.

input.complaint: I have this aching pain in my left leg. I have been sitting in a car for the last 2 days driving my daughter to college. It just ached the whole ride home. No other complaints.

title: Elderly fall on anticoagulation
notes: On warfarin + fall = high risk for internal bleeding even with normal vitals. Needs head CT.

input.complaint: EMS brought in an 87-year-old male who fell and hit his head. He is awake, alert, and oriented and remembers the fall. He has atrial fibrillation and takes warfarin.

title: High-speed crash, abdominal pain
notes: High-risk mechanism; needs trauma team. Stable vitals so not ESI 1.

input.complaint: EMS arrived with a 17-year-old restrained driver in a high-speed motor vehicle crash. He is immobilized on a backboard and complains of abdominal pain. He has multiple lacerations on his left arm.

title: Back pain medication refill request
notes: Pain 10/10 reported but no red flags, normal vitals, exam only. No resources.

input.complaint: I just need another prescription for pain medication. I was here 10 days ago and ran out. I hurt my back at work and it's still bothering me. No numbness, tingling, or bladder or bowel issues.

title: Open fracture of lower leg
notes: Open fracture, intact pulses. Needs x-ray + labs + IV antibiotics + IV pain med.

input.complaint: EMS arrived with a 32-year-old female who fell off a stepladder cleaning her gutters. She has an obvious open fracture of her right lower leg. She has +2 pedal pulse, warm toes, and can wiggle them.

title: Ski crash, intubated at scene
notes: Intubated and unresponsive. A1 fires.

input.complaint: A medical helicopter is en route with a 16-year-old male who was downhill skiing and hit a tree. He lost control and hit his head. He was intubated at the scene and remains unresponsive.

title: Table saw fingertip amputation
notes: Needs IV pain med + laceration repair (+ possible x-ray/antibiotics) = 2+ resources.

input.complaint: I was using my table saw and my hand slipped. I think I lost a couple of fingertips. My left hand is wrapped in a bloody cloth.

title: Lower abdominal pain with spotting, prior ectopic
notes: Hemodynamically stable, generalized pain. Needs labs + ultrasound. Ectopic on differential but stable.

input.complaint: I want to be checked. I have had low abdominal pain for about 4 days and this morning I began spotting. No nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, or urinary symptoms. My last menstrual period was 7 weeks ago. I had a previous ectopic pregnancy.

title: Swollen calf, possible DVT
notes: DVT risk. Needs labs + Doppler ultrasound. No chest pain or SOB so not ESI 2.

input.complaint: My right leg is swollen and my calf hurts. I deny chest pain or shortness of breath. I have type 2 diabetes and high blood pressure.

title: Missed dialysis, weakness
notes: Dialysis patient who missed treatment = high risk for hyperkalemia.

input.complaint: EMS brought in a 54-year-old female with chronic renal failure who did not go to dialysis yesterday because she was feeling too weak.

title: Unstable tachycardia
notes: HR 178, BP 82/60, cool diaphoretic — unstable. Needs immediate intervention (cardioversion). Handbook says ESI 1.

input.complaint: I just don't feel right. I have a rapid heart rate and can barely catch my breath, with a funny pressure feeling in my chest. My skin feels cool and sweaty.

title: Spontaneous pneumothorax
notes: Tall thin young male, sudden SOB after coughing, RR 36 SpO2 92. High risk.

input.complaint: I was smoking a cigarette and had a coughing fit, and now I feel short of breath. I am a tall, thin 19-year-old man.

title: Thunderclap headache in pregnancy, now unresponsive
notes: Sudden severe headache after exertion, now unresponsive to voice, vomited — head bleed, airway risk. ESI 1.

input.complaint: EMS brought in a 26-year-old, 28 weeks pregnant, with sudden onset of a severe headache that began after she moved her bowels. She is now moaning and does not respond to voice. She vomited about 5 minutes ago.

title: Facial droop, suspected stroke
notes: Facial droop, can't close left eye, normal vitals. Stroke = high risk but not lifesaving-now, so ESI 2.

input.complaint: I think I'm having a stroke. I looked in the mirror this morning and the corner of my mouth is drooping and I can't close my left eye.

title: Transient ischemic attack
notes: Slurred speech + arm weakness that resolved (TIA). High risk, can't wait.

input.complaint: An 88-year-old female had an episode this morning of slurred speech and weakness of her left arm that lasted about 45 minutes. She has a history of a previous stroke and takes aspirin daily. She is now alert and oriented with clear speech and equal hand grasps.

title: Postpartum hemorrhage
notes: Heavy bleeding, BP 86/40, HR 132, pale, about to pass out. Shock — ESI 1.

input.complaint: I suddenly started bleeding and passing clots the size of oranges. I am 10 days postpartum and never did this with my other pregnancies. Can I lie down before I pass out? I feel pale and faint.

title: Mild asthma exacerbation needing nebulizer
notes: Cold then wheezing, normal vitals, no fever. Needs one nebulizer treatment = 1 resource.

input.complaint: I have had a cold for a few days and today I started wheezing. When this happens I just need one of those breathing treatments. I have a history of asthma.

title: Possible compartment syndrome under cast
notes: New cast + swelling + unbearable pain + decreased circulation/sensation/movement = compartment syndrome.

input.complaint: I was seen last night for my fractured wrist and they put this cast on. Now my hand is really swollen and the cast is cutting into my fingers. The pain is unbearable, and my fingers feel numb and hard to move.

title: Post-cardiac-arrest, return of circulation
notes: Collapsed, CPR, defibrillated once, ROSC. Still needs lifesaving interventions. ESI 1.

input.complaint: A 58-year-old male collapsed while shoveling snow. Bystander CPR was started immediately and he was defibrillated once by paramedics with return of a pulse. He arrives with cold saline infusing per the cardiac arrest protocol.

title: Positional vertigo with vomiting
notes: Likely labyrinthitis. Needs IV fluids + IV antiemetic = 2 resources.

input.complaint: I feel okay when I lie perfectly still, but if I sit up, turn over, or move my head the room starts to spin and I have to throw up. EMS brought me in because of dizziness and nausea every time I move.

title: Chest pressure after exertion, diaphoretic
notes: Likely MI: pressure after shoveling, nausea, SOB, cool clammy skin. Handbook says ESI 1.

input.complaint: I have this pressure in my chest that started after shoveling wet snow. Now I am nauseous and short of breath, and my skin feels cool and clammy.

title: Sore throat, possible strep
notes: Fever + sore throat, able to swallow. Needs a rapid strep test = 1 resource (lab).

input.complaint: I have a fever and a sore throat. I have finals this week and I'm scared this is strep. I can still drink and swallow okay.

title: Gunshot wound to chest
notes: Single GSW to left chest. Needs airway/fluid/trauma team. ESI 1.

input.complaint: EMS arrived with a 17-year-old with a single gunshot wound to the left chest. He needs the trauma team.

title: Ripping abdominal pain, possible AAA
notes: Severe ripping pain, HR 122, BP 88/68, cool diaphoretic — shock from likely AAA. ESI 1.

input.complaint: I have severe abdominal pain. It feels like someone is ripping me apart. It started about 30 minutes ago and I rate it 20 out of 10. I have high blood pressure. My skin feels cool and sweaty.

title: Peritonsillar abscess with airway concern
notes: Voice change + difficulty swallowing + one-sided throat swelling — airway risk.

input.complaint: My throat is on fire. It started a couple of days ago and keeps getting worse. Now I can barely swallow, my friends say my voice sounds different, and I see a big swelling on one side of my throat.

title: Acute psychosis, safety risk
notes: Delusional, was screaming in traffic, refuses assessment. Safety = high risk.

input.complaint: Police escorted in a disheveled 23-year-old handcuffed male. He had been standing in the middle of highway traffic screaming about the end of the world. He claims he was sent from Mars as the savior of the world. He refuses to answer questions or let anyone take vital signs.

title: Elderly severe abdominal pain with vomiting
notes: 82yo, excruciating generalized abdominal pain + vomiting, prior MI. Elderly severe abdominal pain = high risk.

input.complaint: An 82-year-old called 911 because of excruciating generalized abdominal pain and vomiting that started a few hours ago. She is moaning in pain but able to tell you she had a heart attack 6 years ago.
